name: Norden Cross
headline: A little closer to the wild. A place to make your own.
summary: The Norden Cross vision begins on Donner Summit, in the setting of Sugar Bowl’s snowbound village and Van Norden Meadow. A mountain landscape first; a place to gather and return to, shaped over time.
intro:
The Norden Cross vision begins on Donner Summit, in the setting of Sugar Bowl’s snowbound village and Van Norden Meadow. A mountain landscape first; a place to gather and return to, shaped over time.

This is a fictional buyer brochure prepared for design review. Parcel measurements, condition, pricing, budgets, availability, policies and dates are invented examples, not verified listing facts or an offer. The regional setting is sourced separately. Cabins and lodge are proposed and unbuilt; the map and photographs do not identify an actual parcel.

sections.title: Eight acres. A new beginning.
sections.body: In this illustrative property story, 8.6 acres of mountain woodland open onto southwest-facing clearings. A gravel arrival and a small equipment shed provide a modest starting point. The residential vision is still ahead.

sections.title: A shared way forward.
sections.body: Illustrative 10% company interest: $625,000. Estimated closing allowance: $12,500. Total initial cost: $637,500. Four proposed 1,100 sq ft cabins plus a 1,800 sq ft lodge; 6,200 enclosed sq ft, 8 bedrooms and 8 full + 2 half baths. All buildings are unbuilt.

sections.title: The cost of keeping it well.
sections.body: $840 per month / $10,080 per year per interest after opening. Turnover cleaning $225 per stay; pet cleaning $50 extra. Loan payments and special assessments excluded. Figures are fictional planning allowances.

sections.title: Room for your rituals.
sections.body: 21 nights per interest per year, including up to 7 peak nights. One cabin for four people. Reservations 3–7 nights, up to 180 days ahead. Two future reservations at a time. Rotating holiday priority. Two dogs by advance arrangement. No third-party rentals. Illustrative future policy only.
